card.name: Linking words before worsening of a condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, of, to, may) right before an expected phrase about masking, worsening or exacerbating a disease, mostly in warnings about acute conditions.

modes.label: Obscure the diagnosis or
modes.description: The word "or" after "may obscure the diagnosis" in opioid warnings on acute abdominal conditions.
modes.example: may obscure the diagnosis<< or>> clinical course of patients with acute abdominal conditions

modes.label: Risk or possibility of
modes.description: "of" after risk or possibility, ahead of words like increasing or exacerbating.
modes.example: because of the risk<< of>> exacerbating the psychosis.

modes.label: Other links to flare-ups
modes.description: Linking words before precipitate, mask or worsening.
modes.example: corticosteroids<< may>> mask infection or enhance existing infection.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning worsening, flare or exacerbation, and away from words about illness and recovery.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a warning says a drug could hide or worsen a condition.
